abilities.desc_zh: 无源/组合仪表
abilities.desc_en: Passive/Combo Meter

abilities.title_en: Soundblaster records his Combo success, preventing his Combo Meter from being reset.
abilities.desc_zh: Soundblaster 记录了他的连击成功，防止他的连击计被重置。
abilities.desc_en: Soundblaster records his Combo success, preventing his Combo Meter from being reset.

abilities.title_en: If Soundblaster is hit by a Special Attack Critical Hit or Ranged Critical Hit, his Combo Meter is immediately reset.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果声爆者受到特殊技暴击或远程暴击，他的连击计数器会立即重置。
abilities.desc_en: If Soundblaster is hit by a Special Attack Critical Hit or Ranged Critical Hit, his Combo Meter is immediately reset.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks

abilities.title_en: Soundblaster’s Ranged Attacks have a {{var_1}} chance to Nullify an Armor or Melee Buff on the opponent. Increase chance by {{var_2}} for each 5 points of Combo Meter.
abilities.desc_zh: Soundblaster 的远程攻击有 {{var_1}} 几率无效化对手的装甲或近战增益。 Combo Meter 每 5 点，几率增加 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: Soundblaster’s Ranged Attacks have a {{var_1}} chance to Nullify an Armor or Melee Buff on the opponent. Increase chance by {{var_2}} for each 5 points of Combo Meter.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attack

abilities.title_zh: Buzzsaw 发射 3 发追踪对手的子弹。
abilities.title_en: Buzzsaw fires 3 shots that track the opponent.
abilities.desc_zh: Buzzsaw 发射 3 发追踪对手的子弹。
abilities.desc_en: Buzzsaw fires 3 shots that track the opponent.

abilities.title_en: Hitting an Unstoppable enemy causes Stun for {{var_3}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 击中不可阻挡的敌人会导致 {{var_3}} 眩晕。
abilities.desc_en: Hitting an Unstoppable enemy causes Stun for {{var_3}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 特殊技
abilities.desc_en: Special Attacks

abilities.title_en: After ending a Special Attack, if Combo meter is even, Soundblaster gains {{var_4}} Attack Up for {{var_5}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 结束特殊技后，如果连击计数器为偶数，Soundblaster 将为 {{var_5}} 获得 {{var_4}} 攻击力提升。
abilities.desc_en: After ending a Special Attack, if Combo meter is even, Soundblaster gains {{var_4}} Attack Up for {{var_5}}.

abilities.title_en: After ending a Special Attack, if Combo meter is odd, the opponent gets a -{{var_6}} Attack Debuff for {{var_7}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 特殊技结束后，如果连击计为奇数，对手将获得 {{var_7}} 的 -{{var_6}} 攻击减益效果。
abilities.desc_en: After ending a Special Attack, if Combo meter is odd, the opponent gets a -{{var_6}} Attack Debuff for {{var_7}}.

abilities.title_zh: 信号扰乱 - Soundblaster 可以干扰对手的传感器，阻止他们使用自己的能力。
abilities.title_en: Signal Scramble - Soundblaster can jam the opponent's sensors, preventing them from using their abilities.
abilities.desc_zh:
远程攻击：应用触发率减益效果，使敌人触发减益效果的几率降低 {{var_8}} 至 {{var_9}}。 [最大堆叠数：1]

+{{var_10}} 每级
abilities.desc_en:
Signal Scramble - Soundblaster can jam the opponent's sensors, preventing them from using their abilities.
Ranged Attacks: Apply a Trigger Rate Debuff that reduces the enemy’s chance to trigger Buffs by {{var_8}} for {{var_9}}. [Max Stacks: 1]
+{{var_10}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 快速的一二连击，将对手打飞。
abilities.desc_en: That Megahertz! - A quick one-two combo to send your opponent flying.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_11}} 有机会为 {{var_13}} 进行 {{var_12}} 破甲。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_11}} chance to {{var_12}} Armor Break for {{var_13}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 连击计数器每 20 次命中造成 +{{var_14}} 伤害
abilities.desc_en: Deal +{{var_14}} damage for every 20 hits on the Combo Meter

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击有 {{var_24}} 几率窃取对手当前能量条的 {{var_25}}~{{var_26}}。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks have a {{var_24}} chance to Power Steal {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} of the opponent’s Current Power bar.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击伤害增加 {{var_27}}~{{var_28}}。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Heavy Attack Damage by {{var_27}}~{{var_28}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 减少对手的远程伤害{{var_29}}~{{var_30}}。 （3 星错误地说 {{var_31}}）
abilities.desc_en: Reduce opponent’s Ranged Damage by {{var_29}}~{{var_30}}. (3-Star erroneously says {{var_31}})

abilities.desc_zh: 增加 {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} 的特殊伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Increase Special Damage by {{var_32}}~{{var_33}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为团队的领导灯塔，所有低级别队友都获得 +{{var_34}} 装甲等级。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower tier teammates gain +{{var_34}} Armor Rating.
